description: This file contains shell commands for adding, verifying, and removing an iptables rule that rate-limits ICMP echo-request packets. It appears to be a test script for managing iptables rules related to network traffic control.
calls: iptables -I INPUT 1 -p icmp --icmp-type echo-request -m limit --limit 1/second --limit-burst 3 -j ACCEPT
iptables -D INPUT -p icmp --icmp-type echo-request -m limit --limit 1/second --limit-burst 3 -j ACCEPT
